What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number never updates or appears stalled, this can happen while the courier processes the package. It may take a few days after the label is created for the first scan to appear. 
What you can do:
Wait a few days after shipment for the first tracking update.
Check the tracking link on the courier’s official page regularly.
If there are still no updates after several days, contact the courier directly with the tracking number to ask about the delay.
If tracking hasn’t updated for 3–5 business days and the courier cannot provide information, you can email care@nurosym.com with the tracking number so the shipping issue can be reviewed.

turns.q: How do I find my tracking link?
turns.replyTail:
our tracking link is sent by email once your order ships. 
After dispatch, you’ll receive a shipment confirmation email.
That email includes your tracking number and tracking link.
You can open the link to follow your package’s delivery progress in real time. 
If you haven’t received it yet, it usually means the order is still being processed before shipment.
